QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know before getting started.

What services do you offer?

We help businesses build and grow their digital presence through website design and development, e-commerce, SEO, digital marketing, and creative content including photography and video.

What types of businesses do you work with?

We work with businesses, startups, professionals, and local brands looking to build a stronger online presence. Whether you're starting from scratch or improving something that already exists, we can tailor the work around your goals.

How much does a website or project cost?

Every project is different, so we don't use a one-size-fits-all price. Cost depends on the scope, features, content, and level of customization required. Share your requirements with us and we'll provide a clear proposal before we begin.

How long does it take to build a website?

Timelines depend on the size and complexity of the project. A straightforward business website can typically be completed within a few weeks, while larger e-commerce or custom projects may take longer. We'll agree on the timeline before starting.

Can you help if I already have a website?

Absolutely. We can improve an existing website rather than rebuilding it from scratch. This can include redesign, performance improvements, SEO, content updates, conversion optimization, or adding new functionality.

Do you provide SEO and digital marketing after the website is launched?

Yes. Website development can be combined with ongoing SEO and digital marketing to help your business attract and convert more customers. We can also work with you on these services independently if you already have a website.

Do you also create photos and videos for businesses?

Yes. We offer photography and video production for businesses that need content for their website, social media, advertising, or other marketing campaigns.

What happens after I submit an enquiry?

We'll review your requirements and get back to you to understand the project, goals, and scope. From there, we'll recommend the right approach, timeline, and pricing before any work begins.
